faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about partnering with Hybrid.
faq.documentsQ: What documents do I need to register?
faq.documentsA: You'll need your business license, FSSAI certificate (for restaurants), GST registration, and valid ID proof.
faq.onboardingTimeQ: How long does the onboarding process take?
faq.onboardingTimeA: Most partners go live within 24-48 hours after submitting all required documents.
faq.commissionA: Our commission structure starts at 15% and varies based on location, service type, and volume. Contact our team for a personalized quote.
faq.multiServiceQ: Can I offer both food delivery and ride services?
faq.multiServiceA: Absolutely! Many of our partners operate multiple services. We provide a unified dashboard to manage everything.
faq.commitmentQ: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.commitmentA: No long-term contracts. We believe in earning your partnership every day with transparent terms.
